components.description: An interactive 3D model with Augmented Reality support.
components.name: ModelViewer

props.description: Component id for callbacks.
props.name: id

props.description: Accessible description of the model. Required, and not decorative: it is the only thing a screen-reader user gets.
props.name: alt

props.description: Enable AR and show the AR affordance where supported.
props.name: ar

props.description: Space-separated AR back-ends, most preferred first.
props.name: ar_modes

props.description: Whether AR may rescale the model.
props.name: ar_scale

props.description: `session-started`, `object-placed`, `failed`, ...
props.name: ar_status

props.description: `tracking` or `not-tracking`.
props.name: ar_tracking

props.description: Raw kebab-case model-viewer attributes.  Read-only props, updated by the component:
props.name: attributes

props.description: `{"orbit", "target", "field_of_view", "source"}`. Only user interaction is reported — programmatic changes are suppressed, or a callback that writes `camera_orbit` would re-trigger itself.
props.name: camera

props.description: Milliseconds to coalesce `camera-change` events before updating `camera`. **Do not set this to 0 casually** — the event fires at frame rate, so 0 means a callback per frame per viewer.
props.name: camera_change_debounce

props.description: Let the user orbit, zoom and pan.
props.name: camera_controls

props.description: `"theta phi radius"`, e.g. `"45deg 70deg 2.5m"`. Two-way: also reported back through `camera`.
props.name: camera_orbit

props.description: `"X Y Z"` in metres, e.g. `"0m 1m 0m"`.
props.name: camera_target

props.description: `Slot` components. Hotspots, a custom AR button, a poster, a progress bar — every one of those is a named slot.
props.name: children

props.description: CSS class for the viewer element.
props.name: class_name

props.description: e.g. `"30deg"`.  - min_field_of_view / max_field_of_view (string; optional): Zoom limits.  - min_camera_orbit / max_camera_orbit (string; optional): Orbit limits, `"auto auto auto"` for none.
props.name: field_of_view

props.description: Camera transition speed. Lower is slower; `0` is instant. This is what makes a programmatic camera move read as a flight rather than a jump-cut.
props.name: interpolation_decay

props.description: `{"dimensions": {"x","y","z"}, "variants": [...], "animations": [...]}`, set on load. Dimensions are in metres — this is the prop that removes the bounding-box maths from user JS.
props.name: model_info

props.description: `{"status": "loading" | "loaded" | "error", "progress": float}`.
props.name: model_state

props.description: When True, clicking the model reports the 3D surface point under the cursor through `scene_point`.
props.name: pick_on_click

props.description: Image shown until the model is ready.
props.name: poster

props.description: `{"position", "normal", "uv"}` for the last picked point, when `pick_on_click` is set.
props.name: scene_point

props.description: 0 to 1.
props.name: shadow_intensity

props.description: URL of the `.glb` / `.gltf` model.
props.name: src

props.description: CSS for the viewer element. It has no intrinsic size — give it one.
props.name: style

props.description: `neutral`, `aces`, `agx`, `commerce`, ...
props.name: tone_mapping

props.description: Which touch gestures the page keeps rather than the model.
props.name: touch_action

props.description: GLTF material variant. `None` (or `"default"`) selects the model's default.
props.name: variant_name

props.description: Component id for callbacks.
props.name: id

props.description: Slot content. Any Dash component.
props.name: children

props.description: Added alongside the built-in `dmv-slot` class.
props.name: class_name

props.description: Increments on click. Use as a callback `Input` — this is how a hotspot drives a camera move without any clientside JavaScript.
props.name: n_clicks

props.description: `"X Y Z"` surface normal; controls hotspot occlusion behaviour.
props.name: normal

props.description: `"X Y Z"` in model space. Required for hotspots.
props.name: position

props.description: The slot name, e.g. `"hotspot-1"`, `"ar-button"`, `"poster"`.
props.name: slot

props.description: CSS for the slot element.
props.name: style
